heading: Before you ask
intro: What I build, what I study, and how to reach me, in short. Anything else, I reply within two working days.

items.a: Electrical Engineering at Institut Teknologi PLN, third-year, 3.86/4.00. Circuits, electronics and simulation on one side; applied AI and software systems on the other.

items.q: Electrical or software: which one are you?
items.a: Both, deliberately. The electrical side is the training; the software side is how I make lab work scale. Most of my projects sit exactly where the two meet.

items.q: What is the grading system about?
items.a: A retrieval-augmented pipeline with BERT-based NLP that evaluates over 100 student answers per session. It cut manual grading 60–70% and brought turnaround from hours to under 10 minutes.
I am currently working across SESL, Metadigital Corelab, Pintarkan ID and Yoenrattan. For anything new, write me at the address in the contact section.
Client and lab work stays private, but I can walk through the architecture on a call: Go services, SvelteKit front ends, JWT auth, Postgres schemas.
